title: Stored x-only leaf birthday search on secp256k1 at 124.641683416454713: 38df975c with a hoisted emit base and a key-path tree

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold grouped stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.390000001 over the challenge and fresh algorithm coins (Chen-Stein on cross-node leaf pairs; drops, caps, wrong class indices, label errors, the carry sites of section 3.4 and the fixup meter's cap are charged failure rows; success.md). Its expected total work is at most 2^124.641683416454713 target-group-operation equivalents (1000 AArch64 instructions per unit; at most 240.1834 per leaf), E-averaged over 114 X-groups that stop at the first resolving group, with every walk, key path and defect row charged by history-conditional domination (success.md 6.6); the worst case on every run, 2^188.505443 instructions, is disclosed. Six leaves x(phi^t(X) +- Y) per batched inverse of y_Y^2 - y_X^2 are labelled by 128-bit truncated fraction products of their Fourier components (sections 3.1-3.3; bwd 1281.5 and keys 138.5 instructions per pair); records travel two hops in 256-record blocks and join by hash chains (sections 2, 4); every delivery is charged as executed code. Peak memory at most 2^135.9989 bytes; preprocessing at most 2^118.0361 units, included; no advice; certificate.py checks every declared figure. This is kaankolcu 38df975c (124.645118129451422, declared dependency) with two keys changes (changes.md); credits in proof.md section 9; no prior acceptance or score is a premise. An analytic bound, not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Run the leaf kernels on production points against bit-exact models of bwd and keys (fractions, error bounds, Fourier identity, records, indices, labels), the class tests, both hops and the grouping on a 4 x 4 machine (machine.py), the grouped hash-chain early-abort cases (grouped_paths), the sites and fixups of section 3.4 (sites.py), and every kernel count against certificate.py, which it runs. Budget-limited parts run stated minimums. Not a production-scale attack.
